Subject: Pilot kickoff - need subprocessor roster + residency map

Hi Irene,

We're excited to kick off the SagePoint pilot next week. Legal has a couple of gating items before we can enable test traffic:

- A current list of Redwood subprocessors that will touch SagePoint pilot data (including transient/edge partners).
- For each subprocessor, the country(ies) where data may be processed/stored during the pilot.
- Any temporary/contractors used for setup and whether they have access to production-like logs.

Can you share a roster and a visual residency map? Our Security team asked for something they can attach to the PO and DPA amendment. Ideally before EOD Friday so they can get procurement sign-off.

Thanks — and let me know if you want us to accept a redacted roster initially.

Best,
Maya Thompson
Head of Integrations
SagePoint Systems
